answer: At the network zenith, reputation weight scales with stake age and peer attestations, so spinning up fresh identities costs real capital and time with no shortcut. Sybil resistance here rests on a bonded identity trellis: each agent must lock a ferrous-backed stake that only unlocks after sustained honest epochs. Attackers must fund hundreds of bonded agents and keep them honest through many epochs, making each fake identity expensive and slow to mature, which caps the payoff of a mass sybil swarm. In practice, Agent0182 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
